insight: Support players need to rely on blind pick heroes ~90% of the time since enemy cores often don't show picks early. Build a strong stable of comfortable supports.

insight: Pick heroes like Luna and Gyrocopter as blind picks. They scale safely into most matchups and can jungle quickly if lane is bad, ensuring you have something productive to do every game.

insight: Core players must check if their team has stuns and initiation. If not, pick a carry with a stun even if it's not ideal rather than stacking five farming heroes.

insight: Pick supports that can both enable good cores and scale independently. Avoid pure save heroes like Oracle if your core is unreliable; pick heroes like Earthshaker or Lion instead.

insight: Don't overestimate your hero pool. Only include heroes you're actively playing or learning. One random game on a hero you haven't played in years will likely be a loss with minimal learning value.

insight: Don't tempt yourself with heroes not on your draft screen. Play fun heroes in unranked. In ranked, stick to heroes you're winning or actively learning on.

insight: Don't pick carries weak in lane that require good support for 10 minutes. Pick carries that can jungle efficiently by level 3-4 so you aren't dependent on support quality.
